annotations.title: Where can I go without changing

description: Every station reachable from a GB railway station WITHOUT CHANGING TRAINS on a date, after a time, each with the train that gets there soonest (a later but faster train beats an earlier slow one), sorted by arrival. Includes places reached by staying aboard a train that divides or joins another en route: those rows carry an 'association' naming where, and the passenger must be in the right portion. Timetabled times, not live. Use plan_journey when a change of train is acceptable or a destination is already known.

date.description: Date, yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today (UK time).

from.description: Station to travel from: name or CRS code.

limit.description: How many destinations to return, 1-50, soonest arrival first.

maxMinutes.description: Only destinations reached within this many minutes of departure.

time.description: Leave after this time, HH:mm UK time. Defaults to now.

name: direct_destinations
